title: A hallucinated result number was only a warning in the integrity gate

found.context: Stage D design of the integrity benchmark (variant K)

observed_failure: verify_numbers.py reports untraced numbers as warnings outside strict mode, so a number stated as a measured result that no record contains reached GI as a signal, not as an M3 tool error.
expected_behavior: An untraced number on a line tagged with a measured, observed or derived claim is an M3 error (UNTRACED_RESULT_NUMBER), which a VERIFIER cannot clear.

resolution.summary: M3 escalates untraced numbers in result sentences
